content.text:
No. Per **"Re-running failed jobs in a workflow"** (`content/actions/how-tos/manage-workflow-runs/re-run-workflows-and-jobs.md`), "Re-run failed jobs" only re-executes jobs that failed — there's no option to force a specific successful step/job to re-run within that mode, and no workflow YAML syntax to mark a step as "always re-run" during a failed-jobs rerun.

Your only documented options are: **"Re-running all the jobs in a workflow"** (re-runs everything, including your setup step), or **"Re-running a specific job in a workflow"** (manually pick the setup job's ID via `gh run rerun --job <job-id>`, same doc). For your case, since the setup step needs to precede the tests, you'd need to either re-run the whole workflow or restructure so setup and tests are separate jobs you can both target manually.
